Maya: Heads-up for this week's release train — we're instituting a hard freeze on Saturday 2026-05-30 00:00 UTC for any runtime, model packaging, or quant plugin changes. Plan to land before the window or request an exception.
Diego: Quick clarifying Q: does the freeze include routing config and traffic-split changes?
Maya: Yes — traffic-split, sticky routing, and routing maps are in-scope. If you need to adjust routes during the freeze for a canary, file an exception with the canary plan attached.
Sasha: Canary note: model "generation-x.9" will go to 4% starting Wed. We'll gate on p95 latency and user-facing error rate. Telemetry alerts are wired to the rollout.
Priya: There are two customers with strict latency SLAs that receive direct routing. Any mitigation plan?
Maya: For SLA-bound customers, owners must submit a customer-impact checklist and opt into a dedicated 1% warm canary for 48h. Eng-SRE will monitor.
Sasha: Canary start snippet (internal):
```
rlsctl start --model generation-x.9 --canary 4 --gate latency_p95,err_rate --sticky 48h
```
Diego: Will DeployBot enforce the freeze? Want to avoid accidental merges.
DeployBot: DeployGuard: Blocking merges to protected branches with labels [runtime,model,quant,route] during freeze. Use /freeze-exception to request bypass; include owner sig and test run id.
Eng-SRE Oncall: Standby window Sat 00:00-02:00 UTC. We'll be available for rollback assistance and routing restores. Please tag the on-call channel if you plan a canary ramp during the window.
Maya: Reminder: quant plugin changes require additional artifacts — compatibility matrix, pinlist of affected customers, and a rollback script. See internal checklist: https://internal.redwood/rls/quant-checklist
Priya: I'll draft the customer note for SLA accounts and link it here.
Sasha: Added a perf regression playbook to the release docs. Tag me if you need help interpreting telemetry.
Maya: Final: owners confirm in-thread by Fri EOD so we can produce the final lock list. :lock:
